newsitem.title: USA: Elf Atochem, Nippon Shokubai in venture.
newsitem.headline: Elf Atochem, Nippon Shokubai in venture.

text.p: Elf Atochem and Nippon Shokubai said on Wednesday they planned to form a joint venture to build a 120,000 tonnes per year acrylic acid plant in the U.S. Gulf Coast region.
The companies estimated total capacity spending at $200 million, including money Elf would spend to build its own butyl acrylate plant at the same site.
Elf Atochem is part of France's Elf Aquitaine.

Production from the plant would be for both the United States and world markets, they said. Butyl acrylate production was expected to start in 1999 and acrylic acid production was seen starting by late 2000, they said.
Each partner would be responsible for marketing its own share of the production, the companies said. Acrylic acid is used in superabsorbents and acrylic esters.
